notes: Annual report of the Board of Park Commissioners for the year ending June 30, 1889. Curated: the Children's Quarters and the tunnel to them.

coverage.remaining: Already on the pages: the Key Monument unveiled and the music grounds dedicated on July 4, 1888. Not placed: the ten-acre main lawn between the flagstaffs and the children's house.

findings.description: The children's quarters and their grounds were finished: the two-story house with a playroom below and a restaurant above, its balcony overlooking the merry-go-round, donkey and goat-cart rides, swings, see-saws, spring-boards and maypole, with a ball ground beyond; the playground paid its own way from restaurant and ride takings.

resolution.method: A named park, playground or park building placed on its Recreation and Park place page by the name and streets the annual report give.

findings.description: A tunnel paid for by the Market Street Cable Railway Company was built under the main driveway into the Children's Quarters, so people on foot could reach them without crossing the carriage roads.
